name: Dustin Hoffman
biography: is the president and senior engineer of Exigent Systems Inc., an IT services firm based in Southern California. He’s interested in how all kinds of complex systems work and interact, whether technical, organizational, legal, or economic. He’s held a Private Pilot’s certificate (PPSEL) since 2008.
